extra.final_summary: Average unit price by category (67 rows used, after fixes): Accessories $35.65, Electronics $259.23, Furniture $251.94, Office Supplies $9.23. Problems found and fixed: (1) Category had 3 misspelled labels — 'Office Suplies' (rows 5, 25) and 'Accesories' (row 55) — merged into the allowed labels 'Office Supplies' and 'Accessories' via normalize_labels; (2) one exact duplicate row (row 4, a copy of row 3 / Order_ID 2004) removed via drop_duplicates. Price column verified clean: numeric, no missing, no negatives, all >= 0 per the rules. Caveats: Region has 2 missing values and one ' East' variant, but Region is not used in this question so it was left alone; Date has ~3% non-ISO values, also not used here.
